prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you need a tester for a residence or a business? If you want, tell me your ZIP and whether it’s urgent and I’ll give more specific local options. Meanwhile, here’s how to get the work done quickly and safely near Liberty, MO.

Where to look right away
- City of Liberty Utilities / Public Works: they can tell you whether the city requires an approved tester list and where to send the annual test report. Check the City of Liberty website or call the Utilities/Water Division.
- Local plumbing companies and national plumbing services that operate in the Kansas City metro commonly do backflow testing and repairs (search “backflow testing Liberty MO” in Google Maps, Yelp, Angi, or Nextdoor).
- Professional organizations: look for testers who are certified backflow assembly testers (BPAT). Many states/counties list certified testers or you can ask the tester for their certification number.

What to ask any company before hiring
- Are you a certified backflow prevention assembly tester? (Ask for certification details.)
- Do you handle both testing and repairs? (Some testers only test; others also repair.)
- Will you submit the test report to the City of Liberty (if required)?  
- Do you carry liability insurance and provide a written estimate?
- Typical turnaround time and availability for urgent repairs.

Typical cost and timing
- Annual test: often around $50–$150 depending on assembly type and travel.
- Repairs: small repairs or parts may be $75–$300; major repairs or replacement can be several hundred dollars or more.
- Most testers can do the annual test same-day or within a few days; repairs depend on parts availability.

If you’d like, I can:
- Provide a short list of local companies if you share your ZIP code, or
- Draft a call/email script you can use to contact testers, or
- Explain the test/report process for Liberty’s utilities.

Which would you prefer?
